_doc: W3-B exterior district compiler spec — a 480x320 commercial pocket immediately north of D2 Shopping Center (D2 bbox x0/y0/x1/y1 4100,900,5100,1550 — its own patches start at world y=960). Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/commercial.json -v. Vocabulary comes from data/limezu-visual-catalog/placement-rules.json. Format: docs/EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md. Verified empty ground: no patch, road or stamp of any district (hand-authored or d00-structure) falls in this bbox, so it reads as brand-new plaza frontage for D2 rather than a collage on top of it.
district: D21 Commercial Plaza Pocket (Shopping Center north forecourt)

compiler._doc: coords 'local': every rect/point below is relative to bbox, so relocating the pocket is a one-line bbox edit (EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4).

label: MARKET FORECOURT

surfaces._doc: the paved plaza floor: stalls, awnings and shoppers stand here.

surfaces.name: service_lane
surfaces._doc: a narrow delivery lane along the south edge, mirroring D2/D4's own back-of-house asphalt strips, and the seam this pocket will share with D2's forecourt when the two are joined.

slots.name: market_plaza
slots._doc: canopy/signage run through pass F/G regardless of the plaza archetype's own role list (they scatter per-slot density directly); npc_anchor is a meta role — it validates and reserves the vocabulary slot but the compiler does not yet emit `npcs` entries for it (W4-A TODO, see EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md pass E notes), so 0 stamps from it is expected today. furniture_ext (market tables/benches) matches commercial's own biome density baseline (placement-rules.json biomes.commercial.density).

constraints._doc: 480x320 pocket = 30x20 = 600 cells. coverage_target_singles is deliberately modest: the festive_market-affinity canopy/signage pool for commercial is small once placement-index gaps are subtracted (several me.shopping.*/me.generic_building.awning_* ids from the enrichment are not yet in placement-index.json — see the spec-level _doc and the W3-B compile report).
